title: Privacy Policy
content:
1. Information We Collect

We collect personal details you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and any details submitted through contact forms.

2. How We Use Information

We use your information to respond to inquiries, improve our services, and communicate important updates related to Re:Life Health.

3. Data Security

We implement reasonable safeguards to protect your information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.

4. Contact Us

If you have privacy-related questions, please contact us via the Contact page.
